split.algorithm: Permute sorted gold-passage groups; greedily fill dev20 then train10; rest val10/test80
split.caveat: All100 previously inspected; test80 excludes only this round optimizer data, not historical exposure

multiquery.default_prompt:
You are an AI language model assistant. Your task is
    to generate 3 different versions of the given user
    question to retrieve relevant documents from a vector  database.
    By generating multiple perspectives on the user question,
    your goal is to help the user overcome some of the limitations
    of distance-based similarity search. Provide these alternative
    questions separated by newlines. Original question: {question}
multiquery.actual_line_parser: Native behavior retained; all generated lines reported, no outcome-based cleanup
multiquery.per_k: Truncate every per-query list to k, then equal-weight RRF constant60 to k
multiquery.distinct_document_union: Native framework union saved separately; RRF is our explicit adaptation matching teammate

dspy.strategy: ChainOfThought reader over fixed original-question BM25; NOT a new retriever
dspy.metric: Normalized reference-answer token-F1, lexical proxy only

signature.instructions:
Answer the legal question accurately and concisely using the supplied context.

Preserve qualifications and exceptions. If the context does not support
an answer, state that the supplied evidence is insufficient. Do not
invent case names, statutory provisions or factual details.

reader.system: Answer the question using only the supplied legal passages. If the passages do not support an answer, say that the evidence is insufficient. Give a concise answer of at most 80 words, without a heading.
reader.context: Original title+text passages in rank order, last prefix truncated at word budget; then stop
reader.overhead: Budget counts document title+text only, not labels/question/instructions
reader.metric: Normalized exact match and token-F1; NOT validated legal correctness/accuracy

statistics.primary: Paired exact McNemar for test80 MQR vs BM25 Hit@5
statistics.reader: Three paired token-F1 contrasts vs BM25 reader and unoptimized CoT; sign-flip100000 draws seed42; Holm3
statistics.intervals: Paired question bootstrap95% intervals,20000 draws seed42, descriptive; no source clustering
statistics.caveat: Repeatedly inspected Legal benchmark. Group split isolates current optimization only. No global historical multiplicity adjustment.

cross_dataset_reporting: Long-form schema retains dataset, stage changed, test n, metric name, matched baseline and delta. Legal F1 must not be labeled MC accuracy.
scope: New framework study only. Task1 Q-to-H result is explained from saved evidence without a new HyDE experiment.
